DREAD.THINGS_SCALE_BEETLE.description: At the start of combat, all enemies gain [blue]10[/blue] [gold]Scale Up[/gold].
DREAD.THINGS_BOWLBUG_PROGENITOR.descript: Whenever an enemy dies, other enemies gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold]. If combat starts with only [blue]1[/blue] enemy, it gains [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
DREAD.THINGS_CAVE_GOD.description: At the start of each combat, shuffle [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Debris[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
DREAD.THINGS_HUMAN_FACE_TOWER.descriptio: The first time you play [blue]3[/blue] consecutive cards of the same type each turn, all enemies gain [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
DREAD.THINGS_ABYSSAL_INKMAW.description: At the start of each combat, you gain [red]1[/red] [gold]Weak[/gold] and [red]1[/red] [gold]Frail[/gold], and shuffle [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Slimed[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
DREAD.THINGS_GRAVETIDE_SLUG.description: At the start of each combat, shuffle [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Slimed[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
DREAD.THINGS_THE_LEGACY.description: Starting from the [blue]4th[/blue] card you play each turn, take [red]1[/red] damage whenever you play a card.
